howto: Pick 2 Players, Easy CPU, Hard CPU or Misère and press Play.
You are X and go first. Tap an empty square.
Three in a row across, down or corner to corner wins; a full board is a draw.
In Misère, making three in a row loses.
tips: The centre sits on four lines: take it when you can.
If the CPU takes the centre, answer with a corner, not an edge.
Two open lines at once (a fork) is the only way to beat anyone who blocks.
Hard CPU plays perfectly, so a draw is a good result.
Hint names the best square and says whether it wins, blocks or keeps lines open.

controls.keyboard: 1 to 9 play a square (or Tab/arrows then Enter), Z undoes. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap a square. New Round, Undo and Hint sit under the board.

difficulty: Easy CPU picks any square that does not hand you a win; Hard CPU looks ahead through every move and never loses. Misère turns the rules upside down.

cheats.effect: The CPU naps: you move twice, three times
X-ray: see the square the CPU wants next (pink outline)
Clean slate: the score board goes back to 0-0

features.rules-screen: The title card lists the rules; Pause > How to play has them too, and Replay tutorial brings the card back
features.ai-difficulty: Easy CPU and Hard CPU (perfect play), plus a Misère CPU
features.undo: Undo button (or Z) takes back your move and the CPU's reply; in 2 Players one move at a time
features.results: Win, lose or draw card with the score; the winning line glows and a line is drawn through it
